answer_1.quote: Change captioning aims to generate a natural language sentence to detail what has changed in a pair of similar images.
answer_1.outputs: The tiny red metal block that is to the right of the matte cylinder moved.

answer_2.quote: Following the state-of-the-art methods, we use five standard metrics to evaluate the quality of generated sentences, i.e., BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, CIDEr and SPICE.
